text: Okay, like I literally just told you. I don't remember my email. And I don't remember my email address. How am I supposed to do that? That's not what I asked. Can't you just help me find the order because it's going to Texas by mistake? It's urgent!
zh: 好的，就像我刚才告诉你的。我记不住我的电子邮件。我记不住我的电子邮件地址。我该怎么办？这不是我想要的。你不能直接帮我找到订单吗？因为它被寄到了德克萨斯州，这是错误的。很紧急！
